table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
	itemremarks=item.remarks,   
	salecatcode=saleledger.salecatcode,
	itemsaledesc=saledetail.saleitemdescription,
	saleperson=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packing=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
	custphone=customer.phone,
	custsalestaxregno=customer.salestaxregno,
	custntn=customer.ntnno,   
	custdayslimit=customer.dayslimit,
	CustomerSite = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.saleledger.CustSiteCode),
	CustomerSiteAddress1 = (SELECT P.Address1 FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.saleledger.CustSiteCode),
	CustomerSitePhone = (SELECT P.Phone FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.saleledger.CustSiteCode),
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	headerinvno = dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
	bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
	packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
	Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=ISNULL(saleledger.balance, 0), 
	amt=saleledger.amt,     
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custref=dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	printbalance=saleledger.printbalance,
	reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
	amtreconinv=isnull(saleledger.cashcharged,0)+(select isnull(sum(amount),0) from cashierwindow where cashierwindow.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode)
FROM 
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode,
	dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_23
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) - amtreconinv

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )
